job.job_title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (React, Next.js, TypeScript, AI/LLM)
job.job_description:
Senior Full Stack Engineer

ScreenFire is building a modern digital signage platform for restaurants. We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer who can own product features from concept to production.

Responsibilities

Build end-to-end product features using React, Next.js, TypeScript, and backend technologies.
Design scalable APIs and backend services.
Develop customer-facing dashboards.
Design and optimize data models.
Integrate third-party APIs.
Build AI-powered features using Large Language Models (LLMs).
Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.
Monitor, debug, and improve production systems.
Collaborate on architecture and technical decisions.

Requirements

4+ years of Full Stack development experience.
Strong experience with TypeScript, React.js, and Next.js.
Experience designing REST APIs and backend services.
Strong understanding of databases and data modeling.
Experience integrating third-party APIs.
Hands-on experience building AI/LLM-powered applications.
Strong problem-solving skills and ownership mindset.
Excellent communication skills.

Why Join ScreenFire?

High ownership role with a product-focused engineering team.
Opportunity to build AI-powered SaaS products.
Small, fast-moving team.
Real-world impact with production customers.
Modern technology stack. Role & responsibilities
